name: TEA domain transcription factor 1

function.text: TEAD1 encodes transcriptional enhancer factor TEF-1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of miRNA transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to helicoid peripapillary chorioretinal degeneration (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: The gene appears in specialty educational coverage, but a disease-specific somatic driver relationship has not been assigned in this draft; expression-marker or assay-context mentions are not mutation evidence.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
